title: SWF DefineMorphShape (tag 46) for shape tween export
description: Implement DefineMorphShape (tag 46) encoder in packages/swf for exporting shape tweens. Flash 8 exports two-keyframe shape tweens as a single DefineMorphShape record (startShape + endShape) with the player interpolating. Currently shape tweens emit separate DefineShape4 per frame. The correct export: find adjacent keyframes with tweenType='shape', encode the start and end ShapePath as a single DefineMorphShape tag, then emit PlaceMorphShape with ratio=0..65535 per intermediate frame. Reference: SWF spec §DefineMorphShape. Add to compile.ts in the character pre-pass. Write 8 tests in __tests__/morphshape.test.ts.
